title: As a user, I can reset my password
acceptanceCriteria: Given I forgot my password, when I request a reset link, then I receive an email with a time-limited link.
Given the reset link is valid, when I set a new password, then I can log in with the new password.
Given the reset link is expired, when I try to use it, then I see an error and can request a new link.
openQuestions: What is the reset link expiration time?
commentsToPost: Refinement summary: Added ACs, identified open questions, suggested labels.
